fields.t2: TB2 — top-2-consecutive-hours minus bottom-2 (battery 2h arbitrage spread, €/MWh)
fields.wp: Wind capture price €/MWh — SUM(price·(B18+B19)) / SUM(B18+B19) over CET day. NULL if no wind data.
fields.sl: Solar (PV) capture price €/MWh — SUM(price·B16) / SUM(B16) over CET day. NULL if no solar data.
